entries.wording: Receive item at office of exchange (Otb)
entries.note: Received at the outward office of exchange. Seen in an opened archived capture of the IPS web tracker on webtracking.sonapost.bf, for a parcel sent from Ouagadougou to France; (Otb) marks the outbound leg in Burkina Faso.

Bagged for dispatch abroad. Seen in an opened archived capture of the IPS web tracker on webtracking.sonapost.bf, for a parcel sent from Ouagadougou to France; (Otb) marks the outbound leg in Burkina Faso.

entries.wording: Receive item at office of exchange (Inb)
entries.note: Arrived at the destination country's office of exchange. The (Inb) scans of items posted in Burkina Faso are the destination post's, relayed to the tracker.
Customs handed the item back, a release, which the shared rules would read as customs.

entries.wording: Send item out for physical delivery (Inb)

entries.note: The extra information gives the reason and the measure taken, such as a return to the sender of an unclaimed item.
A post's despatch abroad, from the data it sent; seen for an item returned towards Burkina Faso.
